launchOverview.allInCost: An Operator costs you, all in (WETH-equivalent)
launchOverview.preEpochMarketNote: No buy-in is charged yet, but it is already accruing. Every sale adds its acquisition fee to the reserve, so the buy-in owed the moment the Epoch ends rises with each one.
launchOverview.postEpochMarketNote: The reserve compounds. Each acquisition returns its own buy-in to the reserve, so the buy-in climbs with every sale. Redemption pays out over 5,555 while buy-in divides by 5,554, and both round toward the reserve — so the share held by everyone still holding only grows.
launchOverview.analyticsUnavailable: Market analytics are temporarily unavailable. The canonical market remains available independently.
launchOverview.supplyDefinitionsNote: Public distributed supply subtracts unsold pool inventory from the 800M public allocation. Strict liquid float also excludes unreleased treasury vesting and Vault backing from total supply.
launchOverview.depthNote: Maximum input near each target impact, quoted through the canonical Uniswap market. The fixed 1.5% pool fee is excluded from price impact.
launchOverview.metricsUnavailable: Launch metrics are temporarily unavailable. Trading and Vault actions remain independently verifiable onchain.

solvency.note: These are invariants, not targets. The Vault re-checks all three at the end of every purchase, redemption, credit and repayment, and reverts the whole transaction if any fails.

landing.eyebrow: The anchor is fixed. The market is not.
landing.heroDescription: Every basket is a fixed bundle, always redeemable for exactly what is inside it. No manager, no rebalancing, no liquidations. Markets move around that anchor — Statics pays the people who hold it steady.
landing.heroVisual: Digital marble statue of Robin Hood
landing.heroAlt: A fragmented digital marble statue of Robin Hood wearing a feathered cap and goatee
landing.basketsTitle: Put your bags in a basket.
landing.basketsDescription: Bundle 1 to 16 assets into one token. Trade it as a single position or redeem it for exactly what is inside. No rebalancing. Built for arbitrage.
landing.dollarTitle: Turn ETH into options and dollars.
landing.dollarDescription: Split your ETH into spendable dollars and leveraged ETH exposure. Use the dollars as dry powder while keeping an ETH trade in play. Risk shares take the first loss.
landing.ownPositionDescription: Baskets, loans, and dollar series live in one position you can hold, transfer, or sell as a single asset.
landing.noLiquidationsDescription: Debt is denominated in the same assets as the collateral, so a price crash moves both sides together. There is nothing to liquidate.
landing.deepLiquidityDescription: A share of every swap becomes permanent protocol-owned liquidity. Pools get deeper the more they trade, and that depth cannot be withdrawn.
landing.stakeEarnDescription: Stake and opt into up to 12 reward assets. Rewards are swap fees paid in kind — real revenue, not emissions.
landing.redeemExactly: Redeem for exactly what is inside

position.label: Position

protocolLiquidity.label: Protocol-owned liquidity
protocolLiquidity.plain: Liquidity the protocol holds permanently, rather than any individual person.

priceFeed.label: Price feed

health.label: Health

rewards.label: Rewards

staking.label: Staking

openToAnyone.label: Open to anyone
openToAnyone.plain: No approval or gatekeeper. Anyone can do this.
